title: Renewal Notice Terms: End of a SecureRate Guarantee Period on Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
Terms that apply to an Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contract when a guarantee period of an Ashgrove SecureRate tier ends.

## The renewal window

- When a SecureRate guarantee period ends, a renewal window of the tier's renewal window length begins on the day after the guarantee period end date.
- During the window the owner may withdraw any amount or surrender without surrender charge, or elect a new guarantee period of any SecureRate length then offered.
- The window end is found by adding the window length in calendar days to the guarantee period end date; an election received on that day is in time.
- The guarantee period end date relied on is the one on the contract record, and the date relied on for an election is the date the election request was received.

**Retired sentence.** "A renewal election must be received no later than the guarantee period end date plus the renewal window days." — this sentence is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

## Renewal without an election

Without an election the contract renews on the day after the guarantee period end date into the tier's default renewal period, at the rate then declared for that period under the interest crediting provisions, and a new surrender charge schedule starts on the renewal date.

## Election of a different period

An election of a different period changes the tier to the Ashgrove SecureRate of that length, effective the day after the guarantee period end date.

## The Flexible Premium contract

The Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity has no renewal window; its rate is re-declared each contract year without restarting its surrender charge schedule.

## Counting the window (hypothetical dates, 30-day window)

| Item | Date |
|---|---|
| Guarantee period end date | 31 March |
| First day of the renewal window | 1 April |
| Window end (31 March plus 30 calendar days) | 30 April |
| Election received 30 April | In time — received on the window end |
| Election received 1 May | After the window end |

Calendar days are counted, not business days, and the count starts from the guarantee period end date itself.

superseded_clauses: A renewal election must be received no later than the guarantee period end date plus renewal_window_days.
